changes.title: Wave strings
items: A wave arriving no longer stutters while its string lights go up: the forest they hang in is grown ahead

changes.title: Relic sigil size
items: A relic you carry now shows as its full flask sigil beside your stack, as big as an animal's, instead of a tiny glint

changes.title: Boot sparkler
items: The boot's ley line now runs through the dancefloor's stones, and each turns into its speaker as the sparkler touches it
The boot's pulse burns like the sparkler, and at the end of the boot it carries straight on as the wave's pulse: one sparkler, no gap
Behind the sparkler the ley line is a thin line of ash, and the line's growing end just finishes plainly
Every few seconds a faint ripple runs along each ley line, showing which way it goes
